## About
J.M. Yeary Automotive is a family-owned and operated shop in Kennedale, TX. Mark Yeary founded it and still runs it today, and one reviewer mentions his wife, who runs the office.
We've always kept our family values and we're proud to support our local community. Our customers rate us 4.7 from 60 reviews on Google, and some of them have been bringing us their cars, and their kids' cars, for a long time.
We'll tell you what's going on with your car in plain words, catch the small stuff before it turns into big problems, and get you back on the road.

## Services
- AC & Heating: Heating and air conditioning repair for your vehicle.
- Brake Repair: Brake work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic.
- General Automotive: Everyday repairs from an honest, reliable full service auto repair shop.
- Auto Maintenance: Routine care that protects your vehicle's vital systems and catches small issues before they become big problems.
- Tune-up: Stop by for a quick tune-up service.
- Oil change: One reviewer brought in her granddaughter's car for an oil change and an overheating repair and said the team was quick.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Free estimates are available. Give us a call for more information.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We handle all makes and models, foreign and domestic, including cars, trucks, and SUVs.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Kennedale Pkwy in Kennedale, TX. One reviewer recommends us to anyone in the Forest Hill and Kennedale area.
